mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_link_os_stats (full_short_url, date, cnt, os, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{linkOsStats.fullShortUrl}, #{linkOsStats.date}, #{linkOsStats.cnt}, #{linkOsStats.os}, NOW(), NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cnt = cnt + #{linkOsStats.cnt};
mapper.select: SELECT tlos.os, SUM(tlos.cnt) AS count FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_os_stats tlos ON tl.full_short_url = tlos.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{param.gid} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' AND tlos.date BETWEEN #{param.startDate} AND #{param.endDate} GROUP BY tl.gid, tlos.os;
